title: The confirmation's close X acts as Cancel: nothing changes and the part window keeps the picked status
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. (Admin has Part Library & Inventory > Delete.) QAPL-T1 and QAPL-T2 are active; note the newest entry in each one's Part History.
custom_steps:
1. Parts > Inventory, Active tab: click the QAPL-T1 row; in Edit Inventory Part pick Part Status Inactive and click Save.
  2. Click the close X at the top right of the confirmation.
  3. Click Cancel in the dialog footer (discard the unsaved change if asked).
  4. The actions menu > Deactivate parts; tick QAPL-T1 and QAPL-T2 and click Deactivate on the bulk bar.
  5. Click the close X at the top right of the confirmation.
  6. Leave bulk mode with the bar's X; open the Part History of QAPL-T1 and of QAPL-T2 (row history icon).
custom_expected:
1. "Deactivate part?" opens with the lead "QAPL-T1 {description}".
  2. Only the confirmation closes: Edit Inventory Part is still open with Part Status Inactive still picked; no toast.
  3. The dialog closes without saving; QAPL-T1 is still on the Active tab.
  4. "Deactivate parts?" opens with "2 parts selected."
  5. The confirmation closes; bulk mode stays on with both parts still ticked ("2 selected") and still on the Active tab; no toast.
  6. No new "Deactivated" entry on either part; both are still Active.
